statement: In the two-section-class case of D75, retain the actual other reflection w, its full fixed subgroup B=C_F(w), the original cusp c and unique transporter g, and D60's actual character chi and section a in B. Every open subgroup B0 of B has one-dimensional H1(B0,F2). The actual subgroup generated by a^{e2} is a Sylow pro-2 subgroup of B mapping isomorphically to Z2. Both ker(chi_2|B) and K=ker(chi|B) are pro-odd, and explicit inverse maps identify B with K semidirect Zhat via a. For every finite continuous 2-primary B-module Q, actual inflation identifies H*(B,Q) with H*(Zhat,Q^K), and restriction to the named full procyclic section is induced by Q^K inclusion Q. For every finite E-set X, the proof retains the normalizer factor H0(B,F2[X^T]) direct-sum H1(B,F2[X^T]), its literal restriction, and its perfect mixed cup pairings. The unproved invariant-surjectivity map to the named procyclic section exactly detects K, with a specified finite-coset witness for every nonidentity kernel element.

depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The actual original cusp c, quotient label u, and unique transporter g remain unchanged. The other subgroup is the full centralizer B=C_F(w), not its H1 or a maximal pro-2 quotient. Every open subgroup is realized as a literal stabilizer of a T-fixed point in a finite E-coset set. The Brown idempotent is transported by the actual restriction isomorphism, and its relative lift is defined by the exact long sequence.
computational_checks: No computational claim. The new proof uses exact cochain products, two filtered finite-coefficient spectral sequences, a specified orientation trace, Brown idempotent restriction, arbitrary finite permutation modules, their actual stabilizers, finite-character extensions, and exact averaging maps. A finite sample producer would not establish the universal duality or full-group assertions.
notes: The perfect localized absolute-relative pairing is proved from the transpose differentials and explicit opposite filtration pairings; no transgression for a general coefficient module is assumed zero. The trace for trivial coefficients is the quotient edge map onto the surviving orientation row. The other Brown idempotent kills both actual cusp occurrences, so j:eR->eA is an isomorphism. The resulting perfect normalizer pairing has a square-zero H1 summand, giving an upper bound; the actual chi character gives the matching lower bound for every orbit stabilizer. The pro-odd kernel is an actual subgroup, and B=K semidirect Zhat is retained with explicit inverse coordinates. Triviality of K, surjectivity of the invariant restriction to the procyclic section, and D75.5 recognition remain unproved. No new bibliography key is required.
